description: Define September 1–7 owners and cadence for stabilization, marketing, sales reporting, support, defects, participant experience, Journey/Lumina quality, and Founder briefings. Do not allow operations to fall off after the first 72-hour stabilization window.
agentScope: Michelle owns post-launch operations orchestration, cadence, incident coordination, logging/routing, pause of affected operations, unresolved-item tracking, and Founder briefing. Nia remains CX, social, Support, marketing execution, Triple E, and Journey/Lumina experience owner. Imani remains technical/security/monitoring/defect-fix owner. Kimberly Walker (human) is Founder acceptance and escalation only. Kimberly Walker (AI) is not an operating agent. Lumina is not an operating executive.
planStatus: DEFINED — READY FOR FOUNDER ACCEPTANCE REVIEW
purpose: Single September 1–7 executive operating plan: owners and cadence for the eight named domains, with an explicit continuation rule so operations do not fall off after the first 72-hour stabilization window. This file does not rewrite product, marketing, or legal artifacts, does not start 72-hour stabilization, does not mark Row 211 Complete, and does not invent performance targets.
authorityRule: Do not invent procedures. Use already-approved systems. If two sources conflict, Michelle surfaces the contradiction and does not resolve it by preference. Command Center snapshot dates (September 1–7) govern this plan; stale August 20–26 text in launch-rows.json is not used and is not rewritten here.

antiFallOffRule.statement: The 72-hour stabilization window is the opening intensity, not the end of operations. After the 72-Hour Stabilization Review on September 3, all eight domains continue through September 7 on the Days 4–7 cadence. No domain may go dark, be parked as handled-in-hypercare, or wait for the 30-day review.

continuationWindow.rule: Same eight domains. Same owners. Reduced social-sweep intensity on September 7 only (Row 83 business-day sweeps). All other domains stay daily. Weekend September 5–6 is still operating time, not a pause.
